sources.title: GitHub - adambuttrick/ror-set-point-matching · GitHub
sources.snippet: The set model is too slow to read all 143,284 records for each string. Thus stage 1 uses two faster methods to find about 37 candidates. The retriever is a dual encoder. Its base model is multilingual-e5-base. It changes the string and each record text separately into vectors. Thus the record vectors are made one time, and all strings use them.
